remarks: Brand New!! Be the 1st to live in this totally updated Mid-Ridges home, surrounded by a 1/4+ acre of enclosed level land in a fabulous location. Couple of blocks away from houses of worship, parks, shopping & downtown Stamford. Beautiful custom designed modern kitchen, upgraded appliances & gas stove, breakfast bar & plenty of cabinetry. Both Full Baths are New w/ MBR bath having a 5 function shower & sliding door. Oversized Bedrooms w/ lot's of closet space. MBR suite w/ walk-in closet. Brand new windows - totally light & bright inside. Living room w/ F/P & slider to backyard. Mudroom with heated porcelain floor & entry to backyard & new flagstone patio. Newer vinyl siding & roof - fully insulated (blown-in & foam). New Plumbing, New Electrical, New Gas Heating & Central Air systems (2 zone), New Gas Hot Water heater. Recessed LED lighting, Refinished Hardwood floors, Upgraded landscaping including brand new natural flagstone front walkway, landing & rear patio. Recently paved driveway & new insulated garage door finish this perfect picture of living comfortably. Don't Miss this one!!!
